context: The item is a used smartphone in good condition.
transcript: Buyer ($60): Hello! I am very interested in purchasing your used smartphone in good condition. Would you be open to accepting an initial offer of $60?

Seller ($180): Hi there! Thanks for reaching out, but $60 is a bit too low given the great overall condition and performance of this phone. I'd really love to make a fair deal with you, so I can lower my price to $180 for a quick sale.

Buyer ($100): I appreciate you lowering your price to $180, but that is still a bit above what I can afford. Could we meet closer to the middle at $100? I'm ready to complete the purchase right away if that works for you.

Seller ($160): I appreciate your eagerness to complete the purchase right away! However, $100 is still a bit too low considering how well the phone has been maintained and cared for. I really want to work with you, so I can drop my price down to $160.
Buyer ($140): Thank you for bringing the price down to $160. To show I am serious about making a fair deal today, would you be willing to meet me at $140?

Seller ($150): I really appreciate your serious offer of $140, but $150 is truly the absolute lowest I can accept for a phone in this great condition. If you can meet me at $150, I would be delighted to finalize the sale with you right away!
Buyer ($150): That sounds completely fair, and I am happy to accept your offer of $150. Thank you for working with me to reach a deal that fits my budget. <AGREEMENT>
